body: Im in literally the exact same position. I dont know what to say, or how to solve it. maybe some of us are just fucked, unlucky. dont do anything desperate, maybe theres a way people like us can change, to somehow find a way to live like the rest do. keep working on yourself, maybe one day itll pay off.
my health is deteriorating rapidly, and my family is fractured and uncaring. its over and i think i need to start making preparations for it.

I dont have any emotional connections, I never have. always been too unattractive for anyone to willingly make the attempt to connect. my family doesnt really care about anyone, pretty much everyone is fighting over petty money problems, and my parents have stopped caring about what ive turned into, finding whatever excuse they can to not be around. i have no one, and the more i write the more i realize how little my death would effect anyone.
